caption: The drawing features a beige or light tan background with a thick, wavy brown line running horizontally across the lower half and then curving upward through the middle. Near the top center, there is a solid brown cross. Along the wavy brown line, there are four blue leaf-like shapes each with a yellow central vein, attached by short blue stems. The composition is bordered on the left and bottom edges by straight brown lines. Scattered across the background are several small pink oval or irregular shapes.
title: Colcha
